name: SmartProductSEO Search Engine Submit™
author: jolizzie

sections.description:
Smart Search Engine Submit for WordPress – IndexNow URL Submission helps WordPress website owners notify supported search engines whenever content changes.

When a post, page, or WooCommerce product is published or updated, the plugin can automatically submit the URL through IndexNow so participating search engines can discover the content faster.

The plugin is designed to be lightweight, simple, and performance friendly. No frontend scripts, no frontend styles, and no unnecessary database activity are loaded for visitors.

Features include automatic URL submission, manual URL submission, homepage submission, IndexNow key management, and submission activity tracking.

Video Tutorial

See how SmartProductSEO Search Engine Submit™ works, including automatic IndexNow URL submission, manual URL submission, submission activity tracking, and the per-page Auto Submit control.

Free Features

IndexNow key generator
IndexNow key endpoint support
Auto-submit published posts
Auto-submit published pages
Auto-submit WooCommerce products
Manual URL submission
Homepage submission
Submission activity log
Success and failed submission tracking
Lightweight SmartProductSEO dashboard
No frontend CSS
No frontend JavaScript
HPOS compatible

Why Use IndexNow?

IndexNow is an open protocol that allows websites to notify supported search engines when content is added, updated, or removed.

Instead of waiting for search engines to discover changes through normal crawling, websites can submit URLs directly through IndexNow.

Designed For

Bloggers
WooCommerce stores
Small businesses
Ecommerce websites
Content publishers
SEO professionals
Agency websites
Product catalogs

Performance Focused

This plugin is intentionally lightweight.

No frontend scripts
No frontend styles
No tracking
No bloated reports
No unnecessary cron jobs
Loads admin assets only on plugin pages

WooCommerce Support

Automatically submits WooCommerce product URLs when products are published or updated.

Compatible with WooCommerce product catalogs and stores of all sizes.

External Services

This plugin connects to the IndexNow API to notify participating search engines when URLs are created, updated, or submitted manually.

What the service is used for:
The IndexNow service is used to submit URLs for faster search engine discovery and indexing.

What data is sent:
– Submitted URL(s)
– IndexNow API key
– Website domain associated with the API key

When data is sent:
– When a post, page, WooCommerce product, category, or taxonomy is published or updated (depending on plugin settings)
– When an administrator manually submits a URL
– When an administrator submits the homepage URL

This service is provided by IndexNow.

Website:
https://www.indexnow.org/

Documentation:
https://www.indexnow.org/documentation

Privacy Policy:
https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/privacy/privacystatement
sections.installation:
Upload the plugin to WordPress.
Activate the plugin.
Open “Submit To IndexNow” in the WordPress admin menu.
Verify the generated IndexNow key.
Start submitting URLs automatically or manually.
sections.faq:
Does this guarantee indexing?

No. Search engines decide whether and when a page is indexed. This plugin helps notify supported search engines that content has changed.

Does this work with WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce products are automatically supported.

Does this affect website speed?

No frontend scripts or frontend styles are loaded by this plugin.

Can I manually submit URLs?

Yes. The dashboard includes a manual URL submission tool.

What is IndexNow?

IndexNow is a protocol that allows websites to notify participating search engines when content is added, updated, or removed.
